figures.caption: An empty file rejected by the loader. Two Debug launches show the same caller boundary and unchanged source buffer.
figures.alt: Three annotated IDE details at loader_return. The next instruction is dla t0 last_status, before the caller saves the returned status. Registers show v0 one and v1 zero. The first sixteen source-buffer bytes are zero. Independent file-service checks, rather than this photograph, establish that the acquired descriptor was closed.

figures.caption: Accepted PNG container fields before inflation. Two Debug launches inspect the same publication checkpoint.
figures.alt: Three annotated IDE details at collect_publish_ready before its nop. The first 32-bit word precedes the descriptor. Starting at the second word, little-endian low/high pairs cross table-row boundaries and show capacity 46, width 2, height 5, joined zlib count 46 and predicted inflated count 35. Registers show success v0 zero and v1 46. Inflation and image publication have not run.

figures.caption: The first Up-filtered row after its vector group and scalar tail. Two Debug launches stop at the same first-row boundary.
figures.alt: Three annotated IDE details at row_up_tail_ready before its nop. The first selector remains 02 followed by eighteen fa bytes, reconstructed samples of 250. Offset nineteen holds the next selector 02 followed by eighteen residual bytes 0a, which have not been reconstructed yet. Register a1 is two because the first row has not reached row completion.

figures.caption: Sixteen vector-packed pixels and one pending scalar pixel in the first row. Three Debug launches share the same source and checkpoint.
figures.alt: Four annotated IDE details at pack_vector_advanced before its nop. Sixteen numeric RGB words begin with 0x000061c2 and end with 0x002b8ced. The next destination word remains zero because the seventeenth pixel is pending. Register t1 is one. The source RGB cursor has advanced 48 bytes and the destination cursor 64 bytes.

figures.caption: The completed worked PNG in the compact destination layout. Four Debug launches show the same source, image and publication checkpoint.
figures.alt: Five annotated IDE details at publication_results_ready. The picture is two pixels wide and five rows high in a two-column eight-row display. The last three display rows are unused black rows. The first memory detail shows retained row capacity 786944 followed by published width two. The next detail shows published height five, forty active pixel bytes and the retained A5 suffix, followed by a pointer outside the context. Registers show success v0 zero and v1 forty. The compact recipe uses stride two pixels and retains the one MiB framebuffer allocation.
